name: PuzzleVQA
intro: PuzzleVQA 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中出现的视觉推理问答评测，用于评估模型解决图像谜题类问题的能力。
task_type: 视觉问答, 视觉推理
intro_en: PuzzleVQA is a visual reasoning QA evaluation appearing in the Seed1.5-VL report for solving image puzzle-style questions.

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18; status=source-reconstructed-awaiting-independent-signoff; scope=PuzzleVQA paper-aligned bilingual Build Process, paper-matched implementation, current-repository drift, AlgoPuzzleVQA scope separation, license-time boundary, and source-stage topology contract. Primary evidence is PuzzleVQA v3 at https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13315v3 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2403.13315v3; the reviewed PDF SHA-256 is a7cc824f4ed39c68b578700043dfda744ba73958f99cbe533747df5cbfdd74ab. Official code is https://github.com/declare-lab/LLM-PuzzleTest. The paper-matched implementation is pinned to commit e974881fd10ae24c7eab98ac98788ac88b731a6a, while the current audited repository is pinned separately to 9b3a074cca0cfe3f06ef57acae425992fe98a8fb. PuzzleVQA evaluates abstract-pattern reasoning over four fundamental concepts: numbers, colors, sizes, and shapes without requiring extensive world knowledge. It defines four single-concept and six dual-concept categories, for ten categories total. Each category has two multimodal templates, producing 20 templates. A template defines objects, spatial layout, an abstract pattern, demonstrations of that pattern, and a missing-object query. The generator randomly populates concrete objects while satisfying the template rule, selects and hides one target with a question mark, creates four options in general or three for size questions, and samples distractors heuristically. Python and Pillow render the image. Textual templates construct three distinct ground-truth explanations: a caption for visual perception, a pattern explanation for inductive reasoning, and a deduction statement that applies the pattern to the missing object. Every record contains exactly the semantic fields image, question, options, answer, caption, explanation, and deduction. The paper creates 100 unique instances from each of 20 templates, giving 2,000 test instances and 200 items per category. At the paper-matched commit, the PuzzleVQA/data tree has exactly 20 JSONL files with 100 records each, totaling 2,000. The evaluation uses the same test set and standard Accuracy. The main zero-shot condition supplies image, question, and options with a chain-of-thought trigger that asks the model to describe the image first and think step by step. Diagnostic settings progressively add the ground-truth caption, then caption plus pattern explanation, then caption plus explanation plus the deduction prefix without revealing the answer. This progression diagnoses visual perception, induction, and deduction and is not a data-construction filter. Official get_answer parsing first prefers the last parenthesized choice letter A-D in the raw response and, if none exists, falls back to the last bare A-D. Only if that result is not a valid option does the implementation ask the model to extract a choice using the original prompt, raw output, and explicit trigger. The same parser is then applied to the extraction response: prefer the last parenthesized A-D, then fall back to the last bare A-D, before mapping the letter to an option. At paper commit e974881fd10ae24c7eab98ac98788ac88b731a6a, PuzzleVQA/generation/data_generation.py SHA-256 is 4f12784848893be3cfef08462ccb118eac902b3a6ff7cb995ba6d29969b68439, PuzzleVQA/prompting.py SHA-256 is e7be8ba6639b87eecd59d4c2704f25a4bacb885165f1cccc2b16f9a544fabff0, and PuzzleVQA/main.py SHA-256 is 6e0f5d9db945dda55d89e167953ab8c264839fd13c74ff005f44b9e3477fb484. The paper-matched snapshot contains no LICENSE file. The current audited repository later contains an MIT LICENSE with SHA-256 7622db7d14c31804288e5cb8f50c419844984c54d94a504b93a9c248882bfba4; the graph records that temporal fact without backdating the file to the paper snapshot. AlgoPuzzleVQA is a separate benchmark track in the repository and is deliberately excluded from the PuzzleVQA primary flow even where both coexist in repository history. No human annotation stage, training split, requirement for extensive world knowledge, parser based on the first letter, or merged PuzzleVQA/AlgoPuzzleVQA count is inferred. English and Chinese specs have identical semantic IDs, types, sizes, positions, styles, edge endpoints, edge types, edge styles, waypoints, and modules; every secondary edge explicitly sets dashed=true and no edge carries a label. Canonical six source/spec/architecture paths and two SVG paths remain benchmark-local; Mermaid is null and both fallbacks are empty. Strict Draw.io/XML and runtime visual review are required next; replacement formal assets and refreshed paper_aligned registration remain gated on independent reviewer approval.
